responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend for the Tilera TILE-Gx architecture, covering the machine-dependent configuration, instruction selection, ABI rules, and OS integration needed to compile and emit code for this processor family. Its central implementation and headers define target hooks, register and storage layout, calling conventions, PIC/TLS and code-model handling, prologue/epilogue logic, builtin support, assembler output, and target options, while the machine-description files provide the RTL patterns, predicates, operand constraints, synchronization/atomic expanders, and generic pipeline scheduling/bundling model that map GCC operations onto TILE-Gx instructions. Supporting files add target-specific modes, predefined C/C++ macros, Linux/ELF runtime specs, and precomputed constant-multiplication tables, making this directory the place where generic GCC middle-end and RTL processing are specialized into correct and efficient TILE-Gx code generation.
